articles.title: The hidden opportunity in the next $2 trillion of US–Latin America trade
articles.summary: Our latest research finds that distinctive capabilities unique to Latino business owners and consumers in the United States could create significant growth in one of the world’s biggest economic corridors.

articles.title: Closing the women’s health gap: Switzerland’s CHF 7 billion opportunity
articles.summary: Addressing the women’s health gap in Switzerland could deliver eight additional healthy days per year for every woman and potentially contribute more than 7 billion Swiss francs in annual GDP by 2040.

articles.title: Getting real about AI: How AI agents are changing the economics of software engineering
articles.summary: Cognition co-founder and President Russell Kaplan explains why the next frontier of AI in software engineering is about more than writing code faster and what it takes to turn autonomous agents into measurable business value.

articles.title: What is a forward-deployed engineer?
articles.summary: Forward-deployed engineers work inside another company’s own systems. Three McKinsey leaders explain how FDEs help companies derive impact from AI.

articles.title: Place, purpose, and the path to economic mobility
articles.summary: Where you live shapes far more than you’d think. New research points to how community, place, and connection relate to getting ahead.
